items.title: Randy Weston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The recording was…I had my regular guys: Alex Blake and Neil Clark.

ctx.x: Now your most recent recording is the trio record, “Zep Tepi” Explain “Zep Tepi” and the whole trio session that made that record.

The recording was…I had my regular guys: Alex Blake and Neil Clark. “Zep Tepi” is an ancient Egyptian word, it means “the first time”. It’s when the creator decided to give us music, because it was a time when there was just silence, there was nothing. Then the whole process of creation took place. I’m not a scientist, I’m not an anthropologist but it appears certain things have happened to create the earth. During that process, according to the ancients, there was a period of complete silence, there was nothing.…
There is one song on there, it’s a rather short piece, but it kind of has a Japanese feel to it.
